name: Your Career website and tools
provider: Department of Employment and Workplace Relations
summary: The Australian Government's career site, with Career Explorer, Career Pathways and course search tools for planning study and training.
catches: The DEWR pages we checked don't mention a phone line or one-on-one career guidance sessions. Check the Your Career site for current services.
